'''Brugh Chavana''' is an acrobat in [[Valan Luca]]'s [[Valan Luca's Traveling Show|Traveling Show]].

==History==
He is one of four "[[Chavana|brothers]]" who travels with Valan Luca's circus. They are obviously not brothers - one can tell because of their different nationalities.

==Activities==
He is introduced to [[Elayne Trakand]], [[Nynaeve al'Meara]], [[Thomdril Merrilin]] and [[Juilin Sandar]] by Valan Luca when the four join the show. When Nynaeve invites the brothers to dinner, they all begin to flirt with her, causing a fight between Nynaeve and [[Latelle Luca|Latelle]]. Brugh gets a swollen lip when he tries to break up the fight.{{ref/book|5|24}} They are still with the show when [[Matrim Cauthon]] comes to the show.{{ref/book|10|29}}
